Overview

Saint Petersburg is a city in Saint Petersburg with a population of 5,400,000. Russia’s cultural capital, a stunning city of canals and imperial palaces, home to the Hermitage Museum and White Nights festival. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Sunshine is limited, with about 140 sunny days a year.
